text.p: The merger between Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness Plc will create the world's seventh largest food and beverage company with a combined market capitalisation of 20 billion pounds ($32.5 billion).

It is the 10th largest merger in history, worth 9.76 billion pounds ($15.81 billion) using the yardstick used by takeover experts which measures the value put on the junior partner in the merger, in this case Guinness.

Following are the ten largest mergers in history, using exchange rates and share market valuations prevailing at the time the deal was announced and including the value of debt assumed by the acquirer where applicable. (in billions of dollars).
* Bank of Tokyo Ltd and Mitsubishi Bank Ltd $33.8
* RJR Nabisco buyout by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts $30.6
* Ciba-Geigy AG merger with Sandoz AG $30.1
* Taiyo Kobe Bank Ltd, Mitsui Bank Ltd $23.0
* Bell Atlantic Corp merger with NYNEX Corp $22.0
* AT&T Corp buy of McCaw Cellular $18.8
* Walt Disney Co buy of Capital Cities ABC $18.8
* SBC Communications Corp buy of Pacific Telesis Group $16.5
